title: Nine pieces of feedback across six locations
summary: Colleagues in six locations described how I kept projects aligned and executing, set an architecture vision others adopted, and made it safe to speak up.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: a role or recognition event, not an intervention.
the_call: Bring stakeholders together, clarify priorities and clear roadblocks for the teams.
what_i_did: Coordinated the traceability and defect-triage teams across locations and brought IEC 62304 into the company's AI agent platform.
what_changed: An engineer could not recall the team ever missing a deadline, and respondents urged me to take more credit.

quotes.text: Making others feel safe is extremely important for progress, collaboration, and true innovation. His willingness to help is an example for all.
